description: This file implements a translation utility in Go, focusing on integrating with a document-based AI client for translating text with support for error handling, retries, and placeholder management.

classes.name: PiTranslator
classes.description: A struct managing translation operations through a document AI client, including retry logic and placeholder handling.

methods.name: NewPiTranslator
methods.description: Constructs a new PiTranslator instance with specified source and target languages, glossary, and thinking mode.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Translates text asynchronously, with masking of placeholders and retry logic.

methods.name: TranslateRaw
methods.description: Translates raw text without placeholder masking.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Internal method to perform translation with specified run function and handle retry logic.

methods.name: translateWithRetry
methods.description: Retries translation attempts with exponential backoff up to a maximum number of attempts.

methods.name: translateMasked
methods.description: Performs masked translation, handling placeholders and Markdown formatting.

methods.name: translateRaw
methods.description: Performs raw translation without placeholder processing.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the translation client, releasing resources.
